Button

Triggers an action or event — the primary way users move through the product. Built entirely from design tokens, so colour, size, weight, radius and focus all stay in sync with Figma.

6 variants 3 sizes 4 states Token-driven

Preview

Variants

Six semantic variants. Primary for the one main action per view; the rest support it. Outline / Ghost / On-dark use blue text that turns pink on hover.
Primarybutton/primary
Secondarybutton/secondary
Tertiarybutton/tertiary → pink
Outlineborder/default
Outline · on-darktransparent + blur
Ghosttext only

Sizes

Three heights. Size sets font-size, weight, padding and tracking together via the UI type scale.
SizeHeightFontWeightTracking
Large56px16px7000
Default48px14px6000
Small36px12px6000.4px

States

Four states from Figma — default · hover · focus · disabled. Focus shows a 3px coloured halo matching the button (pink · blue · white @25%); ghost focus uses a blue border. (Loading is a UI extra.)
Default
Hoverprimary-hover
Focuspink halo
Disabledopacity .5
Ghost focusborder/focused
Loadingspinner (extra)

NuGet Download special

The NuGet download CTA — the mark, the label and a caret on one line, with the install count beneath. Its own component, NugetButton, not a Button variant: Figma keeps it as a separate frame beside the button set.
Two sizes — lg 56px with a 16/700 label, md 48px with 14/600. The count is Typography/caption-sm in both, and ships at full opacity rather than Figma's opacity-75, which measures 3.14:1 where 12px text needs 4.5:1.
Defaultbutton/primary
Hoverprimary-hover
Focuspink halo
Disabledopacity .5

Anatomy

The parts of a button and the token each one is bound to.
height → --size-btn-lg fill → --color-button-primary label → --font-size-btn-lg / --fw-btn-lg radius → --rounded-full icon gap → --spacing-sm focus → --shadow-focus-magenta

Code

Copy-and-own HTML — styling comes from the design-system tokens. No framework required.
          
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Get started</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="sm" href="/pricing">Outline link</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" disabled>Disabled</Button>

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • One Primary button per view — the single main action.
  • Pair with Outline / Ghost for secondary actions.
  • Keep labels short, verb-first ("Download", "Start trial").
✗ Don't
  • Don't stack two Primary buttons — they compete.
  • Don't hard-code colours; always use the button tokens.
  • Small (36px) is for desktop / compact & table actions only — use Default (48px) or larger for primary mobile tap targets.
